messages:
Tara: Post-RFC sync: proposing 'safety quant audit pipeline' that splits policy (control plane) from enforcement (runtime). Make quant decisions auditable and reversible.

Diego: Audit how? full outputs or compact events?

Tara: Compact decision events for every request (ts, profile, layer, chosen_bit, reason). Full outputs only for sampled canary requests.

Priya: Enumerated reason codes please: PREFERRED, QUALITY_VIOLATION, MEM_PRESSURE, HW_ERR, MANUAL. Makes alerts simple.

Diego: Storage pressure concern. Store token-diff summaries (hash + diff_len) and keep full outputs to 0.1% sample.

infra-bot: NOTE: referential diffs are sensitive. Encryption and retention policy required.

Tara: Control plane endpoints sketch: POST /profiles, PATCH /profiles/{id}/policy, POST /profiles/{id}/rollout?pct=, GET /profiles/{id}/audit?since=.

Priya: Rollout auto-pause rules? If any slice exceeds slice_limit AND fallback_rate > 1% in 5m -> pause rollout. Otherwise alert.

Diego: Also require customer opt-in flag 'allow_aggressive_lowbit' and 'cost_estimate' metadata before enabling low-bit in prod.

Tara: Runtime change: async per-layer counters in shared mem, flush every 10s. Add dry-run mode to log decisions without enforcing.

Priya: Testing: unit tests for policy, integration with synthetic model for fallback triggers, e2e rollback simulating OOM.

Tara: Action items:
- Tara: RFC patch with schema + proto + rollout semantics.
- Diego: perf microbench and storage estimate.
- Priya: implement async counters and dry-run in runtime prototype.
- infra-bot: include proto schema in registry before staging.

Tara: Target: staging canary in 2 weeks. Will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
